label: AutoMapper profiles
description: Convention-based mapping with per-feature Profile classes. ProjectTo pushes the projection into SQL so only the DTO's columns are selected.
$comment: The crud_* vars are consumed by orm/efcore's CrudService.cs template. All three mapping fragments must define the SAME keys — erb throws on a missing path, and "" is falsy, which is how the template skips a block.

vars.name: AutoMapper
quality_checks: Reads use `ProjectTo<TDto>` rather than loading a collection of entities and mapping it in memory

commands.run: dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package AutoMapper
